title: What is OAuth? Apps connected without passwords | 50agents
description: OAuth lets one app act in another on your behalf without your password: you approve what it may do, and it gets a token you can take back.
definition: OAuth is the standard way to let one app act in another for you without sharing your password: you sign in there and approve.
The app gets a token limited to that, which you can revoke.

example.why: You approve Gmail access in Google's own window; 50agents never sees your password.
